A lush green mountain and dense trees form the background. (2) The parents suddenly step out of the frame, leaving the toddler alone on the road. The child looks around with a curious expression and points toward something off-camera. (3) The toddler walks toward the left edge of the frame. Sunlight dapples the ground through the overhead foliage. (4) The woman runs quickly across the screen from left to right. (5) The man runs across the screen from left to right, following the path of the woman. (6) The woman reappears, running back toward the left while carrying the toddler in her arms. The man follows closely behind her, moving in a rhythmic, playful manner.
